# `auth.totp.verify`

Verify a second-factor code

Accepts a TOTP code or a single-use recovery code on a pending session, then rotates to a full session.

- Method and path: `POST /login/totp`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth totp verify`
- MCP: `auth_totp_verify`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `code` | body | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
